liebermann.notes: From Battle, but perhaps copied from Rochester (cf. He); in William of Malmesbury's Gesta regum after § 297 comes Ip Ml, from the Quadripartitus: Wl lad and the preface to CHn cor, then Malmesbury § 298.

entries.text_de: British Museum Cotton Claudius C IX, 13. Jh., aus Battle, aber vielleicht aus Rochester (vgl. He) copirt, hinter Willelmi Malmesbir. Gesta regum3 § 297 folgt Ip Ml, d. i. aus Quadripartitus: f. 70 Wl lad, u. S. 483; Praef. ad CHn cor, u. S. 542; dann Malmesb. § 298.
entries.text_en: British Museum Cotton Claudius C IX, 13th century, from Battle, but perhaps copied from Rochester (cf. He); after Willelmi Malmesbir. Gesta regum3 § 297 there follows Ip Ml, i.e. from the Quadripartitus: f. 70 Wl lad, below, p. 483; Praef. ad CHn cor, below, p. 542; then Malmesb. § 298.
